title: Make per-origin DAO RX replay floors deletion-resistant
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_persistence.py load_rx_floor treats absence of both per-key slot files as a normal first DAO even after a floor was committed. Deleting both dao_rx_<pubkey> slots therefore resets that pinned key replay floor and permits an old signed DAO to be accepted as fresh, violating spec/05-routing.md lines 259-266 that missing receive state fails closed. Persist an authenticated/anchored catalog or per-key initialization floor tied to the Announce pin so previously initialized keys cannot become unseen through deletion or stale restore; test full deletion and rollback of both slots across root restart.
